items.title: 1.1 Graph of Quadratic Function Using Factors (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 1-3: Unit 1 introduction, 1.1 method (Case-I, Case-II), Challenge!, Recall!, Note, Examples 1-2 with Figures 1.1-1.4

blocks.text: Introduction

Assalam o alaikum! Aaj hum Unit 1 shuru kar rahe hain. Is unit ka asal maqsad yeh hai ke aap functions ko sirf formulas ki shakal mein nahi, balke graph (tasveer) ki shakal mein bhi dekh aur samajh sakein. Kitab ke introduction ke mutabiq is unit mein hum pehle quadratic function ka graph factor form se banana seekhenge, aur graph dekh kar us ki equation nikalna bhi. Phir functions ki do qismein parhenge: algebraic aur transcendental. Us ke baad ahem transcendental functions (trigonometric, inverse trigonometric, hyperbolic, exponential aur logarithmic) aur un ke graphs aayenge. Logarithms ke laws, growth aur decay (barhna aur ghatna), compound interest aur sound intensity jaisi zindagi ki misalein bhi hongi, aur exponential aur logarithmic equations aur inequalities bhi solve karenge. Aakhir mein inverse function ka graph aur graphs ki transformation (shifting yani khiskana, aur scaling yani phailana ya sukerna) parhenge.

Pehle thora peeche chalte hain. Grade-XI mein aap quadratic function \(y = ax^{2} + bx + c\ (a \ne 0)\) ka graph bana chuke hain. Yaad kijiye: is ka graph parabola hota hai, jis ka ek vertex (mor ka point, sab se neecha ya sab se ooncha point) hota hai, aur yeh \(a\) ki value ke hisab se ya to upar ki taraf khulta hai ya neeche ki taraf.

Ab hum yeh seekhenge ke jab yahi function factorized form mein likha ho, yani linear factors (pehli power wale factors jaise x minus 1) ke product ki shakal mein, to graph kaise banta hai. Yeh tareeqa aage ki classes mein bhi bohat kaam aayega, jab aap aise higher-degree polynomials ke graph banayenge jo linear factors mein toot sakte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Factor form hi kyun? Socheye: \(y = a(x - h)(x - k)\) mein x-intercepts seedhe nazar aa jate hain. \(y = 0\) tab hi hota hai jab \(x = h\) ya \(x = k\), kyun ke kisi product ka zero hona tab hi mumkin hai jab koi ek factor zero ho. Standard form \(ax^{2} + bx + c\) mein pehle equation solve karni parti, yahan jawab saamne likha hai.
Misaal ke taur par, \(y = (x - 2)(x - 5)\) dekhte hi pata chal jata hai ke graph x-axis ko 2 aur 5 par kaatega. Aur jab intercepts maloom hon to symmetry vertex bhi muft mein de deti hai, jaise aage dekhenge.
Method to Sketch the Graph

Maan lijiye \(y = f(x) = ax^{2} + bx + c\) ko factorize kiya to \(y = a(x - h)(x - k)\) mila, jahan \(h \le k\) (yani \(h\) chhota ya barabar root hai). Graph banane ke liye neeche diye gaye steps follow karein. Do soorten hain: roots alag alag hon (Case-I), ya dono roots ek hi hon (Case-II).
Case-I: If h < k

Step-1: Graph x-axis ko \(x = h\) aur \(x = k\) par kaatega.
Step-2: \(x = \frac{h+k}{2}\) par \(y\) ki value nikalein.

blocks.alt: An upward parabola for f(x) = a(x minus h)(x minus k) with a greater than 0. It cuts the x-axis at the points (h, 0) and (k, 0). A dashed vertical line x = (h + k)/2 runs from the axis down to the lowest point, the vertex ((h + k)/2, f((h + k)/2)).
blocks.caption: Figure 1.1: graph of f(x) = a(x − h)(x − k), a > 0 (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text: Point \(\left(\frac{h+k}{2}, f\left(\frac{h+k}{2}\right)\right)\) parabola ka vertex hai (Figure 1.1 dekhiye). Figure mein dashed (tooti hui) line \(x = \frac{h+k}{2}\) parabola ki axis of symmetry hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Vertex bilkul darmiyan mein kyun hota hai? Parabola ek seedhi khari line (axis) ke dono taraf bilkul ek jaisa hota hai, jaise titli ke dono par. Dono x-intercepts is line ke dono taraf barabar faasle par hain, is liye yeh line un ke bilkul beech mein hoti hai: \(x = \frac{h+k}{2}\), yani \(h\) aur \(k\) ka average.
Misaal: roots 1 aur 5 hon to axis \(x = 3\) hai. Ab \(x = 3\) function mein rakhein to vertex ki y-value mil jayegi.
Khud sochiye: roots \(-4\) aur \(2\) hon to vertex kis \(x\) par hoga? (Jawab: \(x = -1\).)

Step-3: \(x \to \pm\infty\) par \(y\) ka rawaiya (behaviour) dekhein.
Agar \(a > 0\) ho to \(y \to +\infty\).
Agar \(a < 0\) ho to \(y \to -\infty\).
Is ka matlab hai ke graph dono kinaron (left aur right) par ek hi tarah ka rawaiya rakhta hai: ya dono taraf upar, ya dono taraf neeche.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Dono kinaron par ek jaisa kyun? Jab \(x\) bahut bara ho (door right mein), to \((x - h)\) aur \((x - k)\) dono positive hain. Jab \(x\) bahut chhota negative ho (door left mein), to dono negative hain, aur do negatives ka product positive. Yani dono kinaron par factors ka product positive aur bahut bara hai.
Ab \(a\) se zarb dein: \(a > 0\) ho to sab positive rehta hai (dono taraf upar, pyala seedha); \(a < 0\) ho to sab negative ho jata hai (dono taraf neeche, pyala ulta).

Step-4: y-intercept nikalein:
Function \(y = a(x - h)(x - k)\) mein \(x = 0\) rakhein; graph y-axis ko \(y = ahk\) par kaatega.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Ek chhota sa test: \(y = 3(x - 2)(x - 4)\) ka graph kaise hoga? Pehle khud jawab sochiye, phir neeche dekhiye.
x-intercepts 2 aur 4 hain. Vertex \(x = 3\) par, aur \(y = 3(1)(-1) = -3\), yani \((3, -3)\). \(a = 3 > 0\), is liye pyala seedha, dono kinare upar. y-intercept \(3 \cdot 2 \cdot 4 = 24\), yani \((0, 24)\). Agar aap ne yeh chaaron cheezein theek nikal leen, to aap ne method samajh liya hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Yeh \(ahk\) kahan se aaya? \(y = a(0 - h)(0 - k) = a(-h)(-k) = ahk\). Do minus aapas mein cancel ho gaye. Is liye y-intercept \((0, ahk)\) hai. Ratta lagane ki zaroorat nahi; har dafa \(x = 0\) rakh kar khud nikal lijiye.

blocks.title: Challenge!
blocks.text: Agar \(y = a(x - h_{1})(x - h_{2})(x - h_{3})\) ho, to \(x \to -\infty\) aur \(x \to +\infty\) par \(y\) ka rawaiya kya hoga?

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Challenge ke liye ishara: ab teen factors hain. Door right mein teeno positive, product positive. Door left mein teeno negative, aur teen negatives ka product negative hota hai.
Yani ab dono kinare ulat rawaiya rakhte hain: \(a > 0\) ho to \(x \to -\infty\) par \(y \to -\infty\) aur \(x \to +\infty\) par \(y \to +\infty\); \(a < 0\) ho to bilkul ulta. Quadratic (do factors) mein dono kinare ek jaise, cubic (teen factors) mein ulte.
Case-II: If h = k

Agar \(h = k\) ho to function \(y = a(x - h)^{2}\) ban jata hai. Graph banane ke steps yeh hain:
Step-1: Graph x-axis ko \(x = h\) par sirf chhoota (touch karta) hai, is liye \((h, 0)\) hi vertex hai (Figure 1.2 dekhiye).
Step-2: Phir Case-I ke Step 3 aur Step 4 follow kar ke sketch mukammal karein.

blocks.alt: An upward parabola for f(x) = a(x minus h) squared with a greater than 0. It touches the x-axis at the single point (h, 0), which is its lowest point (the vertex), and rises on both sides.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.2: graph of f(x) = a(x − h)², a > 0 (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Graph sirf chhoota kyun hai, kaatta kyun nahi? \((x - h)^{2}\) ek square hai, aur square kabhi negative nahi hota. Is liye \(y = a(x - h)^{2}\) ka sign \(x = h\) ke dono taraf wohi rehta hai jo \(a\) ka hai, aur \(y\) sirf \(x = h\) par zero hota hai.
\(a > 0\) ho to curve neeche aa kar \((h, 0)\) par axis ko chhoota hai aur wapas upar chala jata hai, jaise gend zameen ko chhoo kar wapas uchhalti hai. Yahi chhoone wala point sab se neecha point yani vertex hai. \(a < 0\) ho to yeh sab se ooncha point hota hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Misaal (hamari taraf se): \(y = -(x - 3)^{2}\). Yahan \(h = k = 3\), is liye Case-II. Step 1: graph x-axis ko sirf \((3, 0)\) par chhoota hai, aur yahi vertex hai. Step 3: \(a = -1 < 0\), dono kinaron par \(y 	o -\infty\), yani ulta pyala. Step 4: \(x = 0\) rakhein to \(y = -(0 - 3)^{2} = -9\), y-intercept \((0, -9)\).
Symmetry ka faida uthayein: \((0, -9)\) vertex se 3 unit left hai, to 3 unit right yani \((6, -9)\) bhi graph par hai. Bas, teen points aur direction se sketch tayyar.

blocks.title: Recall!
blocks.text: \(P(x) = a_{0}x^{n} + a_{1}x^{n-1} + \cdots + a_{n-2}x^{2} + a_{n-1}x + a_{n}\) degree \(n\) ka polynomial hai, jahan \(n\) ek non-negative integer (0, 1, 2, ...) hai aur \(a_{0} \ne 0\). Yani sab se bari power wala coefficient zero nahi hona chahiye, warna degree hi badal jaye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Recall! box mein aakhri se pehla term \(a_{1}x\) chhapa hai, aur 'where' ki jagah sirf 'whe'. Coefficients ki tarteeb \(a_{0}, a_{1}, \ldots, a_{n-1}, a_{n}\) hai, aur \(a_{1}\) to pehle hi \(x^{n-1}\) ka coefficient hai. Is liye \(a_{n}\) se pehle wala term \(a_{n-1}x\) hona chahiye. Upar humne sahi shakal likhi hai.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Steps 1, 3 aur 4 follow kar ke, aur dono x-intercepts ke darmiyan kuch points le kar, hum aise higher-degree polynomial ka graph bhi bana sakte hain jo linear factors mein toot sakta ho.

Is Note ka matlab samajh lijiye: higher-degree polynomial ka vertex wala formula nahi hota, is liye Step 2 chhor dete hain. Lekin x-intercepts (Step 1), kinaron ka rawaiya (Step 3) aur y-intercept (Step 4) ab bhi kaam karte hain. Darmiyan ke kuch points is liye lete hain taa ke pata chale ke do roots ke beech curve upar hai ya neeche.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text: Misaal (hamari taraf se, kitab ki nahi): \(y = x(x - 1)(x - 2)\). Step 1: x-intercepts 0, 1, 2. Step 3: \(a = 1 > 0\) aur teen factors, is liye left mein \(y \to -\infty\), right mein \(y \to +\infty\). Step 4: y-intercept 0. Darmiyan ke points: \(x = \frac{1}{2}\) par \(y = \frac{3}{8}\) (positive), \(x = \frac{3}{2}\) par \(y = -\frac{3}{8}\) (negative). Yani curve neeche se aa kar 0 par upar jata hai, 1 par neeche, 2 par phir upar.

Ab do misalein kitab se hal karte hain. Har misaal mein apne aap se wohi chaar sawal poochiye: graph x-axis ko kahan kaatta (ya chhoota) hai, vertex kahan hai, kis taraf khulta hai, aur y-axis ko kahan milta hai. In chaar sawalon ke jawab mil gaye to graph khud ba khud ban jata hai. Pehli misaal Case-I ki hai aur doosri Case-II ki, is liye dono ko dhyan se compare kijiye.

blocks.title: Example 1
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = 2(x - 1)(x - 3)\). Yeh pehle se factor form \(a(x - h)(x - k)\) mein hai, jahan \(a = 2\), \(h = 1\), \(k = 3\).
Maloom karna: is function ka graph sketch karna (yani mota mota sahi shakal, sahi points ke saath).
Tareeqa: \(h = 1\) aur \(k = 3\) alag alag hain, is liye Case-I lagega. Chaar cheezein nikalenge: x-intercepts, vertex (\(x = \frac{h+k}{2}\) par), dono ends ka rawaiya (\(a\) ke sign se), aur y-intercept. Yeh chaar cheezein mil jayein to parabola ki jagah aur shakal dono tay ho jati hain.

Step 1: x-intercepts nikalein
\[x - 1 = 0 \text{ and } x - 3 = 0\]
\[x = 1 \text{ and } x = 3\]
Yani graph x-axis ko \((1, 0)\) aur \((3, 0)\) par kaatta hai.
Kyun: x-axis par \(y = 0\) hota hai. Aur do cheezon ka product (zarb) sirf tab zero hota hai jab un mein se koi ek zero ho. Is liye har factor ko zero ke barabar rakha.

Step 2: vertex nikalein
\[x = \dfrac{1 + 3}{2} = 2\]
\[y = 2(2 - 1)(2 - 3)\]
\[y = 2(1)(-1) = -2\]
Yani vertex \((2, -2)\) hai.
Kyun: parabola symmetric hota hai (dono taraf ek jaisa), is liye vertex dono x-intercepts ke bilkul darmiyan aata hai. 1 aur 3 ka average 2 hai. Phir \(x = 2\) function mein rakh kar vertex ki height nikali.
Dhyan dein: \(2 - 3 = -1\) hai; yahan minus bhool gaye to vertex upar chala jayega jo ghalat hai.

Step 3: dono ends ka rawaiya
\(a = 2 > 0\), is liye \(x \to -\infty\) ho ya \(x \to +\infty\), dono soorton mein \(y \to +\infty\).
Kyun: jab \(x\) bahut bara (ya bahut chhota negative) ho to \(2x^{2}\) wala term baqi sab par haavi (dominate) ho jata hai, aur woh positive hai. Matlab parabola upar ki taraf khulta hai, pyale ki tarah.

Step 4: y-intercept
\[x = 0:\ y = 2(0 - 1)(0 - 3)\]
\[y = 2(-1)(-3) = 6\]
Yani y-intercept \((0, 6)\) hai. Formula \(ahk = 2 \cdot 1 \cdot 3 = 6\) se bhi yahi aata hai.
Kyun: graph y-axis ko wahan kaatta hai jahan \(x = 0\) ho. Do minus ka product plus hota hai, is liye jawab positive 6 aaya.

Step 5: sketch banayein
Points \((1, 0)\), \((3, 0)\), \((2, -2)\) aur \((0, 6)\) plot karein aur in sab se guzarta hua ek smooth U-shape curve banayein jo upar ki taraf khule (Figure 1.3).
Kyun: yeh points aur khulne ki direction mil kar parabola ko poori tarah tay kar dete hain. Curve gol hona chahiye, nokeela (V jaisa) nahi.

Tasdeeq:
Symmetry se check: \((0, 6)\) ka aaina (mirror) point \(x = 2\) ke doosri taraf \((4, 6)\) hona chahiye.
\[y(4) = 2(3)(1) = 6 \;\checkmark\]
Expand kar ke bhi dekhein: \(2(x-1)(x-3) = 2x^{2} - 8x + 6\), aur vertex ka formula \(x = -\frac{b}{2a} = \frac{8}{4} = 2\) \(\checkmark\). Dono tareeqon se ek hi jawab.
blocks.answer: Upar khulne wala parabola jo \((1, 0)\) aur \((3, 0)\) se guzarta hai, vertex \((2, -2)\) aur y-intercept \((0, 6)\) (Figure 1.3).

blocks.alt: Grid graph of y = 2(x minus 1)(x minus 3). An upward parabola cutting the x-axis at (1, 0) and (3, 0), with vertex (2, minus 2) and y-intercept (0, 6).
blocks.caption: Figure 1.3: graph of y = 2(x − 1)(x − 3) (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Example 2
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = -4x^{2} - 8x - 4\). Yeh standard form mein hai, factor form mein nahi.
Maloom karna: is ka graph sketch karna.
Tareeqa: pehle factorize karenge. Factor form \(a(x - h)^{2}\) nikalegi, yani dono factors ek jaise; is liye Case-II lagega: graph x-axis ko \(x = h\) par sirf chhoo kar (touch kar ke) wapas jata hai, aur wohi point vertex hai.

Step 1: factorize karein
\[y = -4(x^{2} + 2x + 1)\]
\[y = -4(x + 1)^{2}\]
Kyun: teeno terms mein \(-4\) common hai, use bahar nikala. Andar \(x^{2} + 2x + 1\) bacha jo perfect square \((x + 1)^{2}\) hai, kyun ke \((x+1)^{2} = x^{2} + 2x + 1\).
Dhyan dein: \(-4\) bahar nikalte waqt andar ke signs badalte hain: \(-8x \div (-4) = +2x\), \(-4 \div (-4) = +1\).

Step 2: x-intercept
\[x + 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x = -1\]
Yani graph x-axis ko sirf ek jagah \((-1, 0)\) par milta hai.
Kyun: factor \((x + 1)\) do dafa aaya hai (repeated factor), is liye x-intercept sirf ek hai, aur wahan graph axis ko sirf chhoota hai, paar nahi karta.

Step 3: vertex
Function \(a(x - h)^{2}\) ki shakal mein hai: \(y = -4(x + 1)^{2}\), jahan \(h = -1\). Is liye vertex \((-1, 0)\) hai.
Kyun: \((x + 1)^{2}\) kabhi negative nahi hota, to \(-4(x+1)^{2}\) kabhi positive nahi hota. Is ki sab se bari value 0 hai, jo \(x = -1\) par milti hai. Yani yeh sab se ooncha point hai: vertex.

Step 4: dono ends ka rawaiya
\(a = -4 < 0\), is liye \(x \to -\infty\) ho ya \(x \to +\infty\), \(y \to -\infty\).
Kyun: leading coefficient negative ho to parabola neeche ki taraf khulta hai, ulte pyale ki tarah.

Step 5: y-intercept
\[y = -4(0 + 1)^{2} = -4\]
Yani y-intercept \((0, -4)\) hai.
Kyun: y-axis par \(x = 0\) hota hai, wohi rakha.

Step 6: sketch banayein
\((-1, 0)\) aur \((0, -4)\) plot karein. Symmetry se \(x = -1\) ke doosri taraf \((-2, -4)\) bhi graph par hai. Ab neeche khulne wala parabola banayein jo \((-1, 0)\) par x-axis ko chhoo raha ho (Figure 1.4).
Kyun: \(x = 0\) line \(x = -1\) se 1 unit right hai, to us ka aaina point 1 unit left yani \(x = -2\) par hoga, aur wahan height bhi wohi \(-4\) hogi.

Tasdeeq:
\[-4(x + 1)^{2} = -4(x^{2} + 2x + 1)\]
\[= -4x^{2} - 8x - 4 \;\checkmark\]
Factor form wapas expand karne par bilkul diya hua function mil gaya, yani factorization sahi thi.
blocks.answer: Neeche khulne wala parabola jo x-axis ko apne vertex \((-1, 0)\) par chhoota hai aur y-axis ko \((0, -4)\) par kaatta hai (Figure 1.4).

blocks.alt: Grid graph of y = minus 4x squared minus 8x minus 4. A downward parabola touching the x-axis at its vertex (minus 1, 0) and cutting the y-axis at (0, minus 4).
blocks.caption: Figure 1.4: graph of y = −4x² − 8x − 4 (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text: Dono misalon ko saath rakh kar dekhiye. Pehli misaal mein do alag roots the, is liye graph ne x-axis ko do jagah kaata aur vertex un ke darmiyan neeche aaya. Doosri misaal mein function pehle standard form mein tha; factorize karne par repeated factor nikla, is liye graph ne x-axis ko sirf ek jagah chhooa aur wohi vertex bana. Yani pehla kaam hamesha yeh hai ke function ko factor form mein le aayein, phir dekhein ke factors alag hain ya ek jaise. Us ke baad baqi kaam (vertex, direction, y-intercept) bilkul mechanical hai. Exam mein graph banate waqt har important point par us ke coordinates zaroor likhiye, kyun ke examiner unhi ko dekh kar marks deta hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Factor form \(y = a(x - h)(x - k)\) mein x-intercepts \(x = h\) aur \(x = k\) seedhe nazar aate hain.
2. Vertex: \(x = \frac{h+k}{2}\) par (roots ka average); yeh \(x\) function mein rakh kar vertex ki height nikalein.
3. \(a > 0\): pyala seedha, dono kinaron par \(y \to +\infty\). \(a < 0\): pyala ulta, dono kinaron par \(y \to -\infty\).
4. y-intercept: \((0, ahk)\), ya seedha \(x = 0\) rakh dein.
5. Repeated factor \(a(x - h)^{2}\): graph x-axis ko sirf \((h, 0)\) par chhoota hai, aur wohi vertex hai.
6. Intercepts aur vertex plot karein, symmetry se ek aur point lein, aur smooth gol curve se jor dein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \((x + 1)\) se root \(x = 1\) parh lena. Sahi root \(x = -1\) hai; factor ke andar ka sign ulta ho jata hai.
2. Aage wala constant bhool jana: \((2x - 1)(2x + 1) = 4(x - \frac{1}{2})(x + \frac{1}{2})\), yani \(a = 4\), aur roots \(\pm\frac{1}{2}\) hain, \(\pm 1\) nahi.
3. Case-I mein vertex ko kisi ek intercept par rakh dena. Vertex hamesha dono ke darmiyan, un ke average par hota hai.
4. Repeated factor wale graph ko x-axis ke paar le jana. Woh sirf chhoota hai.
5. Nokeela V-shape banana. Parabola hamesha gol aur smooth hota hai.
6. \(-4\) jaisa negative common factor nikalte waqt andar ke signs na badalna.
